headline: YA Group Acquires Delphi Precision Imaging
summary: YA Group acquired Delphi Precision Imaging, adding advanced industrial CT scanning and nondestructive inspection capabilities to support product development and failure analysis.
why: YA Group is an international construction consulting and forensic engineering firm expanding its technical inspection and investigative services portfolio.

impacts.name: YA Group
impacts.why: YA Group announced the acquisition of Delphi Precision Imaging.
